protocol.scope: Post-release exploratory recorded-BBO decomposition; not a new registered study.
protocol.denominators: Waterfall: signal-mid notional. Separate returns: entry-price notional. Do not mix either with the original full-cohort mean.
protocol.common_set: Each signal must have original-order signal quote and valid full-depth entry/exit quotes at all six delays. Ex-post measurement conditioning, not an executable entry filter.
protocol.same_millisecond_rule: At signal and zero delay, only quotes already written by the signal record are available. Positive-delay and exit timers use the last quote in their timestamp bucket, matching frozen market-before-timer priority. Millisecond clocks do not establish submillisecond ordering or actual wire latency.
protocol.source_gate: Reject the whole derivative session on any recorded receive regression, sequence conflict, unknown book unit or incompatible original contract metadata. Never repair by sorting.

resumed_from.scope: Trusted local outputs from the interrupted authenticated computation, bound to unchanged price arithmetic and pinned original identities. These slots were not independently re-executed in this invocation.

fee_frontier.scope: Algebraic scenario frontier on the same ex-post common set; negative values require assumed taker rebates, not a verified fee tier or maker result.

original_primary_reference.scope: Original full cohort only. Supplement uses stricter session and common-opportunity gates; its levels must not be substituted for this estimate.

performance.peak_rss_scope: Current invocation only; the interrupted prefix peak was not recorded.

limits: Each signal is replayed in isolation; overlapping signals share market moves, are not independent samples and do not form an inventory-constrained portfolio.
Common-set conditioning uses future quote/depth availability; it is not an implementable selection policy.
One-second exit is measured from the signal, so holding time decreases as entry delay increases.
Unknown fills, races, propagation, market impact, funding and perpetual margin are not calibrated.
Strict derivative eligibility changes coverage. Missing and rejected sessions remain unknown, not zero P&L.
No confidence intervals, model selection or automatic deployment. Zero-delay is a descriptive reference.
